desc.zh: 聖靈開了心眼，真正看懂
desc.zs: 圣灵开了心眼，真正看懂
desc.en: The Spirit opens your eyes to truly grasp it
Persuaded in your heart, willing to accept it
Concretely doing it in daily life

desc.zh: 持續操練直到成為習慣
desc.zs: 持续操练直到成为习惯
desc.en: Practicing again until it becomes habit

desc.zh: 生命影響生命，傳給下一位
desc.zs: 生命影响生命，传给下一位
desc.en: Life touching life, passed on to the next person

note.zh: 改變觀念的八大步驟——每一部都是一趟完整的旅程：資訊只是起點，繁殖才是終點。你在11部中對每一部走到第幾步，此圖會依你的閱讀進度與宣告紀錄自動標示。
note.zs: 改变观念的八大步骤——每一部都是一趟完整的旅程：资讯只是起点，繁殖才是终点。你在11部中对每一部走到第几步，此图会依你的阅读进度与宣告纪录自动标示。
note.en: The eight steps of changing a mindset — each Part is a complete journey: Information is only the starting line; Multiplication is the finish line. This map marks how far you've gone in each of the 11 Parts, based on your reading progress and declarations.
